static.scope: 31 nodes, 19 wires, 15 experiments; uniform declarations match bindings for both materials (20 vec4 uniforms and 3 samplers each).

glsl_compile_standins.scope: glslangValidator, GLSL 4.60 and Vulkan SPIR-V (-V -R) against stand-ins for TouchDesigner built-ins (TDFog included), for the four shaders plus define variants: vertex with TD_PICKING_ACTIVE (since the family close, the documented #ifndef ... #else branch), pixel with TD_NUM_COLOR_BUFFERS 3 and 8, and the pixel shader's own fallback with the define left out. Two negative tests: the vertex shader without its uFlow declaration, and the picking variant without the TDWritePickingValues() stand-in, both fail and name what is missing.

shader_properties_preview.scope: 44 property tests of the delivered GLSL in WebGL2 (Chromium SwiftShader, 480 x 270): the brief's four (amplitude 0 equals the current core, max difference 0 over 23 render pairs, two of them at Object size 1.45 in both, three on a torus scaled 3 by its COMP at each Fit's Object size and three at 481 x 271 in a flipped raster; rebuilt normals within 0.5 degrees of float64 in nine cases and within 1 degree at the Amplitude maximum, where the surface is squeezed (verifier round V1); silhouette coverage changes; crack-free box), the flow tests, and 23 family-sync tests (R1 morph frame, speed nudge and a week of drift; R5 wobble and faceted normals at any scale, IOR 1 with wobble; R6 frost shift and convergence; C3 dispersion convergence; R7 chord thickness near, far and orthographic, no dark fringe; R8 energy conserving and sRGB; C1 transparent and empty scenes, opaque scene vs the core's 6a58487 pixel stage; C2 three colour buffers; C5 half-float cap; C6 flipped raster and Flip V; C7 fog stand-in; C8 Object size 0.1 and 10 (both size names set, so reference runs measure only C8); C9 backdrop menu). Red runs against the 6a58487 material: checks/results/red-run-6a58487.json. Verifier gap round: film_swirl_frequency_0_is_one_drifting_thickness (uFilm.w = 0 gives one film thickness that drifts; Wobble speed 0 stops it) and render_pass_keeps_foreground_in_front (an opaque ball in front of the moving glass stays in front with the Render Pass route, max 1/255; the Over TOP control paints the glass over it, max 246/255). Family close (2): fit_size_carries_presets_over_comp_scale (COMP scale 0.1 and 10 at the sizes Fit sets, every case 1/255, 0 pixels over 8) and screen_orientation_has_no_wrong_pixels (at most 1 single-sample and 5 multisampled wrong pixels per row of twelve moving renders, also at 481 x 271). Fit threshold (family critic, 2026-11-02): fit_size_carries_presets_over_comp_scale also holds 2/255 at every pixel (measured: 1/255); a worldScale() exponent of 0.3333 now fails it (checks/results/red-run-fit-threshold.json). Since the centre-line residual round, screen_orientation_has_no_wrong_pixels allows at most 10 wrong multisampled pixels per row (20 before).

unit_tests.scope: 91 tests. Centre-line residual (2): CentreLineResidual checks the family's open question (same words in every member alongside), the native check and its edit, that no shader has a centroid qualifier yet, and that the records match the preview results; both fail on the records before this round (checks/results/red-run-centre-line-residual.json). Before that, 89 tests. Fit threshold (1): FitThreshold reads the pass condition and the claim of the preview test fit_size_carries_presets_over_comp_scale and requires the 2/255 clause, here and in the core, Flow and Lit where they sit alongside; it fails on the test file before this round and the others pass (checks/results/red-run-fit-threshold.json). Before that, 88 tests. Fit helper name (3): FitHelperName checks that native.py defines fit_glass() with fit_flow as an alias of the same function, that the pulse callback, the usage note and the README call fit_glass(), that every member checked out alongside defines and calls fit_glass, and that every decision making Object size the motion's unit is marked superseded; all three fail before the fix (checks/results/red-run-fit-name.json). Look decisions (2): LookDecisions checks co-design.json look_decisions_for_user against the README and the receipts, and that the code holds the option recorded as in the code; both fail on the records before this round (checks/results/red-run-look-decisions.json). Before that, 83 tests. Family critic (2): FamilyCritic measures the three setups that one Object size per component does not follow (several objects, a Geometry COMP scale that changes after Fit, per-instance scale) with this study's own Fit, and pins the README note to the numbers; it also checks the native list in validation.json family_close.native_run. Both fail on c94e849 and on the current tree without the note and the list (checks/results/red-run-family-critic.json). Before that, 81 tests. Family close critic fixes (1): FamilyCloseCritic pins the Thickness and Object size labels and the core copy's (PV4); it fails on the labels before the fix and the other 80 pass (checks/results/red-run-family-close-critic.json). Before that, 80 tests: presets.py with fake parameters and a fake clock (morph, menu, flow time, drift phase, a 100-frame morph and a slider drag at 1 h, within-frame agreement, pause and resume, two components, a still look, demo spin, colour decoding); the preset callback; native.apply() run alone and in all 225 ordered pairs, with setup kept; Fit to Glass geometry with fake SOPs and COMPs (Flow size, and Object size by the family rule, equal to the core's own fit_glass() on the same geometry); recipe consistency; the pixel shader against the current core line by line; GLSL source rules for R1, R5 to R9 and C1 to C9; README scene route; builder dry run with constant Inputs fields and Info DATs on every render. native_run.how_to_record: Build the component on the target, then run component.op('study_tools').module.inspect(component) and keep build, version, platform and compile_reports (the text of every info_ DAT) as the record. TouchDesigner's Python App class has no GPU member (docs.derivative.ca/App_Class, read 2026-11-02), so copy the chip and GPU from About This Mac. Fill every record field before you change status.

checks.how: Set the demo sphere's Geometry COMP Scale to 3 and press Fit to Glass geometry: Flow size stays 1, Object size reads 3 / 1.45 = 2.07, and the glass and its Wobble ripples look as on the unscaled demo, seen from 3 times as far.

Set the demo render to 481 x 271 (odd both ways). With Flip screen V off, look at Stage screenuv and the bent checker: no one-pixel seam on the centre row or column. Note whether your build's raster runs down or up (whether the refraction needs Flip screen V).
In a scene of your own, follow the README's Render Pass TOP route with an opaque object in front of the moving glass: it stays in front, as in the preview's render_pass_keeps_foreground_in_front.

Point a Render Pick DAT at the demo render and pick over the moving glass: positions and normals lie on the moved surface, not on the SOP's rest shape (the vTDPickVert values the '#else' block sets), an ordinary render is unchanged while the Render Pick DAT cooks, and info_material shows no error for the pick variant.

Family open question (centre-line residual). Set the demo render to 481 x 271 (odd both ways) with Anti-Alias at 4x and Flip screen V off, as in odd_size_481x271. Copy the render, the material and its pixel shader DAT. In the copied DAT, replace `vec2 orient = screenSign(ndc, ndcStep, depthStep, proj);` with `vec2 orient = vec2(1.0, 1.0);`: the orientation every other glass pixel measures in TouchDesigner's usual raster (use -1.0 for y if odd_size_481x271 found that the raster runs up). Point the copied material's pixel shader at the copied DAT and the copied render's Override Material at the copied material. With Pause on, wire both renders into a Composite TOP with Operation Difference. An Analyze TOP with Operation Maximum in RGB gives the largest difference; the pixels that are not black are where the orientation was wrong. Repeat at several Fixed times so silhouettes cross the centre row and column. Record the build, the GPU, how many pixels differ, the largest difference, and whether those pixels show at 100% zoom in the delivered image. The preview's numbers for this study are under preview.
checks.if_visible: If any of them is visible, try a centroid-qualified vertex output for the projected position in Liquid Glass Lit first (Lit's form (e): a second vertex output, `centroid out vec3 vOrientPos`, holding the world position and read only for the projected position in screenSign()). In Lit's preview survey it fixed the usual raster (17 residual pixels to 1) but not the flipped one (18 to 16). Measure it with Lit's survey and this check, then bring it to the core, to Flow with the core's pixel stage, and to Prism. If none is visible, close the open question with this record.

fit_threshold.scope: Family critic (low): fit_size_carries_presets_over_comp_scale accepted up to 50 pixels over 8/255, while every case here measures 1/255. It now also holds 2/255 at every pixel; the family's shared clause (at most 50 pixels over 8/255) stays. Prism (15/255) and Blobs (66/255, 15 pixels over 2/255) keep their own recorded bounds. A scratch copy with the worldScale() exponent 0.3333 instead of 1.0 / 3.0 in liquid_flow.frag (world scale 9.9977 instead of 10) gives film stage 4/255, Oil Slick final 5/255, Aqua Jelly and Prism Chrome finals 2/255; 0 pixels over 8/255: before the fix the test passed when run alone (TESTS filter); with it the test fails when run alone (TESTS filter). Here amplitude0_matches_core already caught the same slip (up to 2/255 on 3 of its 23 renders, the torus scaled 3 by its COMP), so the gap was in the fit test's own claim. Unit test FitThreshold.test_fit_size_test_holds_2_255_at_every_pixel, red on the test file before this round. The core and Liquid Glass Lit made the same change. No shader, uniform, preset or capture changed. WebGL2 preview (SwiftShader), not a TouchDesigner render.

Final image (checks/results/centre-line-residual.json; each render drawn as delivered and with the orientation set to the right value, 4x multisampled canvas): 8 pixels change in 144 renders, at most 4 per row, 4 by more than 8/255, the largest by 38/255 (Violet Gel on the knot, normal raster, 480 x 270); in the normal raster, TouchDesigner's usual orientation, 2 pixels, by up to 38/255.
